adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining makes this a no-op, so any `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from team members are silently dropped. This matches the finding and is directly verifiable from the diff.
